protocol.ci: paired-difference bootstrap n_boot=5000 seed=42, CI95 percentile; SIG = CI excludes 0
protocol.selector: iter_bm25 topk=12 iter_hop_topk=4 chunk_size=512 -- IDENTICAL across every retrieving arm
protocol.scorers: BABILong babilong.metrics.compare_answers (imported); RULER harness per-item `correct` (imported, not recomputed)
protocol.recall: HIT iff every gold-support chunk is in the top-12 pack; decided independently of answer accuracy
protocol.aggregation: PER-CELL ONLY. No pooled BABILong / LongEval figure is computed anywhere -- they average cells of opposite sign.
